summary: St. Joe NF crow's nest in Benewah County, abandoned as a lookout; firelookout.com says it is still there, and no recent description of the site was found.

facts.status_note: Abandoned as a lookout. Firelookout.com says the crow's nest is still there; the other two sources say only that it was abandoned.

access.note: On St. Joe National Forest land; Idaho Fire Lookouts classes it as hike-in; no closure or permit described

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as hike-in.

evidence.supports: crow's nest, dated to the 1930s, and abandoned
crow's nest still there, per firelookout.com
on the St. Joe National Forest
listed as Crowsnest, Abandoned, with coordinates 47.30290, -116.28170

corrections.why: Firelookout.com says the crow's nest is still there, and the FFLA list gives the status as Abandoned, not Gone. No source read says the structure is gone. Human check advised, since the firelookout.com note is undated.

sources.title: Forest Fire Lookout Association, Idaho lookout list

notes_for_editor: The record's status gone is not supported by any source read: firelookout.com says the crow's nest is still there, and the Idaho and FFLA lists say abandoned. The 'still there' note on firelookout.com carries no date, so it may be old. Idaho Fire Lookouts has no documented staffing history for the site, so no staffing is stated. A current photo or visit report would settle the structure's condition.
